scope: GNU Fortran 13.2 default REAL=binary32, strict serial FOM capture; not a product acceptance approval
discrete: Exact field sets, lengths, IDs, association indices, counts, disposition, candidate set/order and threshold decisions; no fuzzy ties
rationale: A small binary32 rounding allowance for this bounded serial corpus, stricter than S1 proposed FOM targets. It does not cover arbitrary scale/size, undefined results, optimized reduction orders or other compilers. Failure requires investigation, never automatic tolerance expansion.
